user.title: Mitsubishi Connect — North America
user.description: Enter your existing Mitsubishi Connect account for Canada or the US. This integration reads cloud reports and location; it does not control or explicitly wake the vehicle. Home Assistant stores these credentials in its configuration. No remote-control PIN is needed.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Update the Mitsubishi Connect credentials for this vehicle.

error.invalid_auth: Mitsubishi Connect rejected the sign-in. Check your email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read Mitsubishi Connect. Check connectivity, subscription, and cloud service availability.
error.rate_limited: Mitsubishi Connect is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
error.no_vehicles: No vehicles were returned for this North American account.
error.vehicle_not_found: The configured vehicle was not found in this account.

abort.vehicle_not_found: That vehicle is no longer available in the account.

init.title: Cloud polling and GPS
init.description: Vehicle state is polled at this interval. Health reports are read at most every 15 minutes unless you use Refresh cloud reports. Polling reads cached reports; it does not guarantee new vehicle data. Turning GPS off removes the tracker, but existing recorder history is retained.
